purpose: Preserve individually reviewed non-secret deployment materials without preserving execution authority
scope: Deployment-material recovery only; this is not a claim that the full project, dependencies, runtime or production service is recoverable
trustedInputs: A separately frozen expected-scope.json containing each required artifact ID, role, original SHA-256 and dependency IDs, and each ordered transfer relationship
A per-file content-review attestation bound to the exact included body SHA-256

review.includeOnly: approved-nonsecret, exact body digest reviewed, reviewer and time recorded, findings empty

completeness.complete: All required original bodies, reviews, hashes, dependencies and transfer relations pass; no gaps
completeness.partial: Every missing required original body has an explicit gap; contradictions, unsafe included bodies and broken references remain invalid

verifierEffects: read the supplied frozen scope and manifest
read the supplied archive body files
forbiddenEffects: read a live deployment or environment
integrationStatus: Reviewable standalone contract and validator; not wired into a publisher or production restore path
